greet.speaker: The Alchemist's Shade
greet.text: A pale figure hunches over a workbench of shattered glass, still measuring reagents that turned to dust decades ago. It turns — too slowly — and its voice is a dry whisper. "Almost. I was almost there."
greet.text_zh: 一道蒼白的身影俯身在滿是破碎玻璃器皿的工作台前，仍在秤量早已化為塵埃的藥劑。她緩緩轉過身來，聲音乾澀如風：「就快了。我明明就快成功了。」

choices.text_zh: 工作台已經安靜下來了。

battle_start.speaker: The Alchemist's Shade
battle_start.text: "No. No, I won't stop now — not when I'm this close!"
battle_start.text_zh: 「不。不，我不會現在停下——都到這一步了！」

already_won.text: The glassware lies still and silent. Whatever kept her working has finally let her rest.
already_won.text_zh: 玻璃器皿靜靜躺著，不再作響。無論是什麼支撐著她不斷工作，如今終於讓她得以安息。
